To tailor what counts as “abroad” and identify realistic AI PhD directions and programs, please provide:
- Your citizenship and current country of study/residence
- Current/highest degree, field, institution type, GPA or class rank, and expected graduation date
- Main AI interests (e.g., machine learning, computer vision, NLP, robotics, AI safety, or interdisciplinary AI)
- Research, publication, internship, and programming experience
- English proficiency/test status and any other language constraints
- Funding needs, budget limits, and preferred or excluded countries

- Citizenship is not specified. I currently study and reside in Jiangsu, China.
- I am an undergraduate in Computer Science and Technology at a prestigious university in Jiangsu. My academic performance is excellent, and I have received school scholarships for two consecutive years. My exact GPA/class rank and expected graduation date are not specified.
- My main interests are AI and algorithm research, especially deep learning and natural language processing. I prefer applied, implementation-heavy, system-building work over purely abstract theory.
- I have substantial hands-on programming and self-directed learning experience using PyCharm, VS Code, GitHub, Coursera, and technical resources, and I have participated in programming competitions. Specific formal research projects, publications, internships, and programming languages are not specified.
- My English proficiency, test status, and other language constraints are not specified.
- Strong funding or scholarships and cost-effectiveness are important. No exact budget, preferred countries, or excluded countries are specified.
